requirements.statement: The greenhouse node measures temperature and humidity for greenhouse monitoring.
requirements.verificationMethod: Run a functional greenhouse monitoring test and confirm temperature and humidity readings are captured and stored as timestamped measurement records.

requirements.statement: The greenhouse node measures soil moisture for greenhouse monitoring.
requirements.verificationMethod: Run a functional greenhouse monitoring test and confirm soil moisture readings are captured and stored as timestamped measurement records.

requirements.statement: The greenhouse node measures light for greenhouse monitoring.
requirements.verificationMethod: Run a functional greenhouse monitoring test and confirm light readings are captured and stored as timestamped measurement records.

requirements.statement: The node reports the readings remotely for greenhouse monitoring.
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm that recorded measurements can be transmitted for remote viewing as part of a periodic reporting workflow.

requirements.statement: The node must capture periodic timestamped measurement records for temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light so they can be reported remotely.

sourceReference.sourceLocator: periodic acquisition needed for remote reporting

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm that measurement records include timestamps and can be assembled into remote reporting summaries.

requirements.statement: The system must achieve acceptable measurement accuracy/error bounds for temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light readings for greenhouse monitoring (accuracy value unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm acceptable error bounds for each modality are captured as open questions before component-level decisions in later workflows.

requirements.statement: The node must meet targeted sampling and reporting interval needs for greenhouse monitoring (interval values unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm sampling cadence and remote reporting frequency so later architecture can size storage/buffering and timing behavior without assuming components.

requirements.statement: The system must operate with remote communication constraints suitable for greenhouse reporting (communication range/network availability unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm communication constraints are captured as open requirements before selecting specific communication technologies.

requirements.statement: The system must meet power-source constraints required for long-duration greenhouse operation (power/operation constraints unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm power-source and operational duration constraints are captured before component selection.

requirements.statement: The node must be suitable for the greenhouse deployment environment (deployment exposure and ingress/environment constraints unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm deployment environment characteristics are captured as open questions before making physical design choices in later workflows.

content.requirementSummary: The greenhouse sensing node must measure temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light and report readings remotely, while confirming open constraints for deployment environment, acceptable accuracy, sampling/reporting intervals, and remote communication and power feasibility before component selection.
